title: Berlin's Two Princes
summary: A city reunited by day and still split by night.

claims.text: By night Kindred still guard a border that no longer exists for mortals, fighting over hunting grounds, havens and which prince truly rules Berlin.
The East Berlin Kindred fight to win back what they once held, while the West Berliners fight to keep what they gained.
For decades the two princes ran separate domains, rarely acting against each other but always watching.

title: Gustav Breidenstein
summary: The Ventrue Prince of Berlin, who held the city with strict laws.

claims.text: Gustav ruled Berlin for more than sixty years, and in that time none dared break the laws.
Gustav joined the Camarilla along with the few other Kindred in the area as soon as the chance came.
Gustav's dislike of other clans led to a war with the Toreador, settled when the prince offered formal apologies and sacrificed three of the prince's own childer before an assembly of Cainites.
The Brujah who ruled Eastern Europe have vanished, and Gustav knows no help will come from them.

title: Baba Yaga and the Fall of the Wall
summary: How a waking Methuselah shook Berlin.

claims.text: Baba Yaga stirred from torpor in 1990 and set out to bring the eastern lands back under the Nosferatu elder's control.
Before Baba Yaga woke, the Berlin Nosferatu fed Gustav false reports and stirred up mortal dissent.
Even Gustav was caught off guard when the crossing points opened on November 9, 1989; hoping to win back lost ground, the prince let the Wall come down from June 13, 1990.
With the eastern Brujah gone, the magical barriers between the two halves of the city have fallen as well.
